name: Quebec: catalogue of bills given assent (metadata only, no law text) and legal-system facts
label: Quebec
record_note: Metadata only, no law text: the Government of Quebec does not allow its statutes to be reproduced without prior authorisation. The catalogue lists the 496 bills given assent (sanction) from 2014-06-10 to 2026-06-12 (41st to 43rd Legislatures), each dated by its assent day, with title, bill number and annual-statute chapter; checked against the National Assembly records on 2026-10-30.

dates.commit: catalogue: the assent (sanction) day; legal-system: the dated Wikidata fact, else the items' latest revision

reuse: No law text is reproduced. Bill numbers, titles, assent dates and chapters are facts recorded by the Assemblée nationale du Québec; the legal-system facts are from Wikidata (CC0).
